name: Beijing Aerospace Shenzhou Intelligent Equipment Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Aerospace Shenzhou Intelligent Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the railway vehicle operation safety detection and maintenance systems, intelligent testing and simulation systems and microsystems and control components, and automation equipment for the nuclear industry and special environments in China.
